scope.description: A single Raft node that is a voter in its configuration, over a caller-supplied StableStore whose writes may be delayed, while it handles a heartbeat-shaped AppendEntries on the transport callback and later runs its own election.
assumptions: the StableStore accepts SetUint64 for the LastVoteTerm and CurrentTerm keys
the vote record is the durable record the node consults before granting a vote
the delayed store write is a legal environment for an injected dependency
excluded: log replication and commitment correctness, which the earlier obligations covered
the wider outcome of two leaders in one term, which depends on other voters
any requirement on transports outside this module

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: StreamLayer is replaced by an in-process net.Pipe fabric; NetworkTransport, its heartbeat classification, the SetHeartbeatHandler registration, requestVote, appendEntries and electSelf are the target's own code.

StableStore is an InmemStore wrapper that holds exactly one CurrentTerm write inside SetUint64. This is a latency injection on an injected dependency; no term comparison, vote rule or write order in the target is changed.

The harness reads the durable vote record directly from the StableStore instead of inferring it from RPC responses, and it reads the pair twice before accepting it so a concurrent election cannot tear the observation.
No target file is modified; the harness adds one external test file to the captured package.

plan_uncertainties: The witness establishes the local vote-record violation only; two leaders in one term additionally require the other voters' records to be corrupted the same way, which this prefix does not contain.

The delayed StableStore write is an injection on an injected dependency, exercised through the documented transport callback; the interleaving it exposes follows from the entry point running off the main goroutine, which the plan cites rather than re-derives here.

The second vote is caused by the node's own election timer, so its timing is bounded by HeartbeatTimeout and ElectionTimeout rather than being instantaneous; the harness waits for the record to change and reads the pair twice before accepting it.
The identity fields are fixed harness labels for a single node and single prefix, so correlation is unique but not discriminating across multiple operations.
Only the vote-record path is observed: no leader is elected and no log is replicated in this prefix.
grounding_unresolved: the number of voters that must be affected before two leaders in one term can result
whether a repair in the term publishing path alone is sufficient given the candidate path's unconditional write
the witness shows the local vote record being reused; whether a second leader in that term becomes possible depends on other voters' records and is not part of this prefix
whether the intended repair belongs in the term update path or in electSelf's unconditional persistVote
whether a second leader in the shared term can follow from the same defect on other voters
